granite.retained: Exact original authored erosion and actual moss carpet/tuft/petal solids, exported base linear color and roughness, original moss image maps/UVs and instance colors
granite.notPorted: Stone/edge/roof original world-space gn noise at frequencies8/5/8,148,317; per-mineral darkening/quartz contribution; original1.5mm and0.5mm world-space noise differential bump at87 and219. These three original shader hooks are explicitly assigned to the native stone clone materials but absent from the portable export.
granite.interpretation: The resulting physical stone is visibly too smooth and pale. Missing granite hooks and the independently diagnosed wrong solar azimuth are both material limitations of R09b; this is not a verified source-direction/material equivalence frame.

wood.retained: Original lacquered cherry albedo, normal and roughness PNGs, metric UVs, original linear material gains, normalXY scale, coat/roughness parameters and instance colors
wood.notPorted: World-space anisotropic weathering wf(P*[3.1,.32,3.1]), high frequency chip wf(P*38), native age/chip color modulation. Native coat normal texture is not one of the official portable exported texture channels, so it is not retained as a separate coat-normal input.
wood.caveat: Only known explicitly patched native base keys are asserted here. Several source clone records share the name wood; this audit does not infer that every clone retained an onBeforeCompile function.
